Class CellIterator.MutableCell

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.tfx.CellIterator.MutableCell
Enclosing class:
CellIterator
public static final class CellIterator.MutableCell extends Object
A mutable cell wrapper that allows modifying cells in the buffer.

This class is designed to be reused across iterations to avoid object allocation. Call reset(int, int, Cell) to prepare it for a new cell position.
